IONRIFT.RESPITE.APP.Pf2eEarlySupportCont:
Respite's Pathfinder 2e support is early. The core rest flow (activities, campfire, terrain events, comfort tiers, and recovery) is functional.

However, some PF2e-specific mechanics are not yet implemented:

  • Treat Wounds (Medicine activity)
  • Refocus (Focus Point recovery activity)
  • Repair (Shield / equipment repair)
  • Subsist (Earn income / forage equivalent)

If you hit a bug or have a suggestion, please report it on Discord. Your feedback shapes what gets built next.

IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_desert_de: The heat has not broken. The rocks are still radiating warmth hours after sunset.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_desert_oa: Wind-scoured ground reveals the edge of a buried cache. Old trade goods from a lost caravan.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_desert_sa: The evening wind picks up without warning, quickly howling into a blinding gale. A violent sandstorm threatens to bury everything in camp.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_desert_sc: The camp was pitched over a scorpion nest. Pale shapes are emerging from the sand.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_desert_st: The vast desert night sky is overwhelming. Countless stars stretch from horizon to horizon. A shooting star traces a line across the void.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_disaster_: A wall of brown water surges through the campsite. The river has burst its banks.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_dungeon_b: The air is thick and still. The fire gutters. Something is wrong with the ventilation.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_dungeon_c: Deep gouges score the stone walls near camp. Three parallel lines, wide-set, dragged downward. The stone dust at the base is fresh.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_dungeon_s: Behind a collapsed shelf, a pack. Not old. Someone else camped here, and did not leave by choice.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_dungeon_v: Vermin are emerging from the walls and floor. The camp is on top of a nest.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_dungeon_w: Movement in the corridor outside. Something is passing through this section of the dungeon.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_forest_bi: The first birds begin before dawn. One song, then another, until the canopy rings with it. The air smells of damp earth. A good omen for the day ahead.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_forest_cl: The watch finds a small clearing carpeted in wildflowers. Mushrooms ring the edges in perfect circles.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_forest_de: A creak and groan from above. A dead branch, heavy with rot, shifts in the canopy directly over the sleeping camp.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_forest_mi: A thick fog rolls in from the lowland. Everything beyond arm's reach disappears.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_forest_wo: Low growling from multiple directions. Eyes glint at the edge of the firelight, circling.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_swamp_bog: The moisture seeps into wounds and scratches. Infections bloom overnight.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_swamp_lee: The damp ground is alive with leeches. They find every gap in clothing and armour during the night.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_swamp_mia: A putrid fog rolls in from deeper in the swamp. The stench is overwhelming, thick enough to taste.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_swamp_sta: Ripples in still water. Something is approaching camp from the marshes. It moves without sound.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_swamp_wil: Pale lights drift between the twisted trees, hovering just above the water's surface. They pulse gently, beckoning. Nobody follows them. That is the wise choice.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_tavern_ba: A bard plays a familiar ballad. The hearth is warm. The road feels far away.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_tavern_br: A heated argument near the bar. The innkeeper steps in before it escalates.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_tavern_ca: The local cat curls up on your bed and purrs.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_tavern_go: The common room buzzes with local gossip about recent strange occurrences.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_tavern_me: A merchant displays trinkets and curiosities on a velvet cloth in the corner.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_urban_nig: The city hums gently tonight. Distant music, baking bread, a yowling tomcat.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_urban_noi: The neighbourhood is not settling down tonight. Shouting, bottles, running footsteps.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.DATA.EVENT.evt_urban_pat: The city watch is making rounds. Lanterns and chainmail approaching.

IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.alchemistSupp: Respite: Qualifies for the Alchemy crafting profession during rest. Characters proficient with these supplies can brew potions and concoctions during the Activity phase.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.bedroll.off: Respite: Bedroll tracked for rest flavour. Comfort rules disabled. No HD bonus applied.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.bedroll.on: Respite: A character carrying a bedroll recovers +1 Hit Die during a long rest, regardless of camp comfort level. This bonus stacks with normal HD recovery.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.berries: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Foraged fruit. Can be eaten raw or used as a cooking ingredient. Spoils after 3 rests. Recipes using berries tend to produce preserves that last longer.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.birdEggs: Respite: Perishable (1 day). Foraged or gathered from nests. Fragile and quick to spoil. Used as a cooking ingredient.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.choiceCut: Respite: Perishable (1 day). A prime cut from an exceptional hunt. Spoils after 1 rest but produces superior meals when cooked. Higher-quality recipes may require choice cuts specifically.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.cooksUtensils: Respite: Qualifies for the Cooking crafting profession during rest. Comfort rules disabled. No exhaustion advantage applied.

Respite: A character carrying Cook's Utensils gains advantage on the exhaustion save during rest when the campfire is lit. Also qualifies for the Cooking crafting profession, allowing the character to prepare meals that grant temporary buffs.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.curedFish: Respite: Cured fish. Shelf-stable (does not spoil). Equivalent to rations for the Meal Phase. A cooking output that preserves fish for travel.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.fish: Respite: Perishable (1 day). Caught fresh from rivers or marshland. Spoils after 1 rest if not cooked. Used as a cooking ingredient for fish-based recipes.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.freshMeat: Respite: Perishable (1 day). Raw game meat from hunting. Spoils after 1 rest if not cooked or preserved. Used as a cooking ingredient for recipes that call for meat. Cooking transforms it into a meal that feeds the party and may grant temporary buffs.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.fruit: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Foraged fruit. Can be eaten raw or used as a cooking ingredient. Spoils after 3 rests.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.healersKit: Respite: Used during the Tend Wounds activity. Grants advantage on the Medicine check and adds 1d4 to the healing roll (1 charge spent). Characters with the Healer feat use the feat formula (1d6 + 4 + target level) instead.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.herbalismKit: Respite: Qualifies for the Herbalism crafting profession during rest. Characters proficient with this kit can gather and prepare herbal remedies, antidotes, and poultices during the Activity phase.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.herbs: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Aromatic herbs foraged in the wild. Essential cooking ingredient for many recipes. Also used in herbalism. Spoils after 3 rests.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.jerky: Respite: Dried, seasoned meat strips. Shelf-stable (does not spoil). Equivalent to rations for the Meal Phase. A cooking output that preserves meat for long journeys.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.medicinalHerb: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Medicinal herbs foraged in the wild. Used in herbalism recipes and some advanced cooking. Spoils after 3 rests.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.messKit.off: Respite: Mess kit tracked for rest flavour. Comfort rules disabled. No exhaustion advantage applied.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.messKit.on: Respite: A character carrying a mess kit gains advantage on the exhaustion save during rest, but only when the campfire is lit. Without a fire, the mess kit provides no mechanical benefit. Functions identically to Cook's Utensils for this purpose.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.mushrooms: Respite: Perishable (3 days). Foraged fungi. Can be eaten raw (with some risk) or used in cooking. Spoils after 3 rests.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.pavilion: Respite: A large pavilion tent provides Shelter during rest. Provides full weather protection and significantly reduces the encounter DC.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.rations: Respite: Consumed during the Meal Phase of a long rest. Each character requires 1 ration per day (some terrains require 2). Characters who go without food risk exhaustion after their grace period expires. Rations are automatically decremented during the rest flow.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.tent: Respite: Provides Shelter during rest. Shelter reduces the encounter DC and can negate minor weather effects.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.tinderbox.off: Respite: Tinderbox tracked for rest flavour. Comfort rules disabled. Fire phase is bypassed.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.tinderbox.on: Respite: Required to light the campfire during the Camp phase. Without a tinderbox (or equivalent), the party cannot start a fire, losing access to cooking, warmth bonuses, and campfire-dependent activities. One tinderbox serves the whole party.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.tinkersTools: Respite: Qualifies for the Tinkering crafting profession during rest. Characters proficient with these tools can repair gear or craft small mechanical devices during the Activity phase.
IONRIFT.RESPITE.ENRICHMENT.waterskin: Respite: Consumed during the Meal Phase of a long rest. Each character requires 1 waterskin per day (desert and arid terrains require 2). Dehydration is tracked separately from hunger and triggers a CON save. Waterskins are automatically decremented during the rest flow.
